source.coordinate_space: slot image (SF_BOOT at 0); component ranges are header + table offset

finding: the eight components measured here (SPBM, SSPM, CPUEB, HFRP, DPM, SPM, GPU, PLL) are high entropy (7.9-8.0), consistent with compression or encryption; nothing in them is a readable operating-point table, and the GPU partition holds no readable container tag. High entropy does not by itself distinguish encryption from compression: the UEFI component is also 8.00 and is a decodable LZMA stream.
what_would_close_it: a plaintext vendor BSP, register map or BCT schema
a decrypted component from a unit, if one is ever obtained
a supported, side-effect-free read of the programmed controller state

model.what: a 4 KiB window of the documented fields, served over SMCCC 0xC400008D
model.why_that_id: the firmware's own SMC filter drops function ids it does not know, so a fresh id never reaches EL3. The OEM id the firmware already forwards is used, with a lab GUID of this repository's own, in the same request shape the RTC and fan services use
model.policy: a write to an OS limit slot (0x100..0x10c) is mirrored into the effective slot (0x160..0x16c). That single relationship is what the interface table supports; the real arbitration between OS, EC and UEFI claims lives in SPBM, which ships encrypted
model.demonstrated: probe: effective 0 -> write OS PL1 45000 -> effective 45000 -> restore -> effective 0, PL-OK

extraction.base: the MediaTek image header's position inside the slot image (0x203000 for all three capsules held)
extraction.verified_by: the UEFI component's embedded FILEINFO descriptor decodes to the 33554432-byte uefi.fd this repository boots, for 2.155.11, 2.158.15 and the Dell 4.1.0 capsule
extraction.why_it_matters: slicing at the raw table offsets lands 0x203000 early: BL31 reads as erased (0.0% non-FF) instead of 98.4%, and every entropy here was recomputed after the correction

measured_scope: these eight; the record makes no claim about BCT, STMM, FLASH, ESPI, OSR_FW, which are lower-entropy for their own reasons
